title: SpeC2Rust: Specification-Driven Repository-Level C-to-Rust Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legacy C codebases remain central to system software and performance-critical infrastructure, but their weak memory safety imposes security and maintenance risks. Recent C-to-Rust translation systems, including LLM-based translators, make automated migration increasingly feasible, yet they still struggle to recover repository-level intent, avoid raw pointers and unsafe constructs, maintain cross-file interfaces, and repair compilation and validation failures efficiently. We propose SpeC2Rust, a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation. It has three stages: (1) Project-Intent Structuring, which decomposes a C repository into semantically coherent modules and generates persistent repository- and module-level specifications; (2) Spec-Guided Generation, which translates each Rust module against these specifications with a live symbol registry to preserve cross-file consistency; and (3) Layered-Feedback Repair,

translated_title: SpeC2Rust：规格驱动的仓库级C到Rust翻译
translated_abstract: 遗留的C语言代码库仍然是系统软件和性能关键型基础设施的核心，但其薄弱的内存安全性带来了安全和维护方面的风险。近期的C到Rust翻译系统（包括基于大语言模型的翻译器）使得自动化迁移日益可行，但它们仍然难以恢复仓库级的意图、避免使用原始指针和不安全构造、维护跨文件接口，以及高效修复编译和验证失败。我们提出了SpeC2Rust，一种规格驱动的仓库级C到Rust翻译流水线。它包含三个阶段：(1) 项目意图结构化，将C仓库分解为语义连贯的模块，并生成持久的仓库级和模块级规格；(2) 规格引导生成，依据这些规格翻译每个Rust模块，并借助实时符号注册表来保持跨文件一致性；(3) 分层反馈修复。
tldr: SpeC2Rust提出了一种规格驱动的三阶段流水线，通过项目意图结构化生成持久化的仓库级与模块级规格，结合实时符号注册表的规格引导生成和分层反馈修复，实现了仓库级C代码到安全Rust代码的自动翻译。
en_tdlr: SpeC2Rust proposes a specification-driven three-stage pipeline that enables repository-level C-to-Rust translation by structuring project intent into persistent specifications, generating Rust modules guided by these specifications with a live symbol registry, and employing layered-feedback repair.
